decision: Approve 29 new naming conventions proposed by the v0.1 atom specs, approve three previously proposed conventions they reuse, and widen two existing conventions (surface-material-tone, unavailable-measurement-message) so the atoms can reuse them.

userConfirmation: atoms, hagamos una cosa...no me preguntes, aplica tu las opciones sugeridas y si tengo que irerar en la revisión ya lo vemos
no dejes pendientes. todo de una cuando definamos specs. añade captura y acepta props
evidence.proposal: Atom spec drafts v0.1 (odd/tasks/atom-specs.md, tasks T2–T6) proposed these conventions; the owner delegated acceptance of recommended options and asked for props to be accepted with each spec.

limits: Assistant-recorded human delegation, not provider-native, signed or independent review authority.
Approval binds names and semantic convention content, not component implementation; owner review in each component issue may revise names, which then requires a new approval record.
No usages are recorded: none of these atoms has source yet; usages are added with reviewed source evidence at implementation.
surface-elevation stays proposed (no atom uses it).
Widened entries keep their IDs; surface-material-tone now covers semantic status tones despite its historical ID.

convention.name: tone
convention.meaning: A component's color tone: a semantic status family or a material surface tone; values are component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: Select the tone family a component supports, such as Badge or Mark status tones.
convention.avoid: A consumer-selected measurement condition (use state), arbitrary colors, or assuming every component exposes the same tone values.

convention.name: unavailableText
convention.meaning: Readable fallback when a displayed measurement (Gauge, Stat) is unavailable and no value is exposed.
convention.whenToUse: Propose non-empty unavailable-data text separately from invalid-input policy approval.
convention.avoid: Loading, disabled state, fabricated zero measurements or assuming fallback wording is approved.

convention.name: variant
convention.meaning: Visual treatment within a component's responsibility.
convention.whenToUse: Choose presentation such as an outline or segmented treatment.
convention.avoid: Consumer-selected condition or Surface material tone.

convention.name: defaultValue
convention.meaning: The initial value of an uncontrolled interactive component.
convention.whenToUse: An actual interactive API supports uncontrolled initialization.
convention.avoid: Passive measurements such as Gauge or APIs without uncontrolled behavior.

convention.name: onValueChange
convention.meaning: Notification of a user-driven value change in an interactive component.
convention.whenToUse: The component actually emits selection or editing changes.
convention.avoid: Passive displays such as Gauge or notifications for incoming prop updates.

convention.name: badgeIcon
convention.meaning: System glyph shown in a small decorative badge overlaid on a corner of the component, such as the network of a channel avatar.
convention.whenToUse: Mark the origin or network of the represented entity with a corner glyph.
convention.avoid: Leading glyphs next to content (use leading-icon/icon), counts or status (use Badge or StatusDot), or the sole source of meaning.

convention.name: paused
convention.meaning: Shows the represented entity as paused or inactive with visual de-emphasis and data-state="paused".
convention.whenToUse: A channel, account or similar entity is paused and the meaning is also given in text.
convention.avoid: Disabled controls (use native disabled), loading, or as the only cue for the paused meaning.

convention.name: icon
convention.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology.
convention.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text.
convention.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning.

convention.name: iconPosition
convention.meaning: Which side of the visible label a component's decorative icon slot is rendered on.
convention.whenToUse: A labelled control or link exposes an optional decorative icon that may lead or trail its label.
convention.avoid: Icon-only controls, icon identity or size, or reordering meaningful content.

convention.name: loading
convention.meaning: The control has started an operation that is still pending; it stays focusable but cannot be activated again.
convention.whenToUse: An action control shows in-progress feedback for an operation it triggered.
convention.avoid: Disabled semantics, data-fetching placeholders, skeletons or progress with a known value.

convention.name: asChild
convention.meaning: Render the component's behavior and styling onto its single child element through Radix Slot instead of its default element.
convention.whenToUse: A consumer must supply the element, such as an anchor or a router link, while keeping the component's contract.
convention.avoid: Multiple children, wrapping non-element content, or changing the component's semantic role.

convention.name: onCheckedChange
convention.meaning: Notification of a user-driven change of a binary or mixed checked state, receiving the next checked state.
convention.whenToUse: A checkbox or switch control emits its next checked state when the user toggles it.
convention.avoid: Selection of a value among options (use onValueChange), pressed buttons (use onPressedChange), or notifications for incoming prop updates.

convention.name: pressed
convention.meaning: Controlled on/off pressed state of a toggle control, exposed as aria-pressed.
convention.whenToUse: A single control persists an on/off state the user switches by pressing it.
convention.avoid: Selection of a value from a set (use value), form checkbox semantics (checked) or transient active styling.

convention.name: defaultPressed
convention.meaning: Initial pressed state of an uncontrolled toggle control.
convention.whenToUse: A toggle control supports uncontrolled use alongside the pressed prop.
convention.avoid: Controlled components without uncontrolled behavior or value-based selection.

convention.name: onPressedChange
convention.meaning: Notification of a user-driven change of a toggle control's pressed state, with the next boolean.
convention.whenToUse: A toggle control emits pressed changes from user interaction.
convention.avoid: Value selection changes (use onValueChange) or notifications for incoming prop updates.

convention.name: onFiles
convention.meaning: Notification carrying the files the user picked, dropped or pasted into a file target.
convention.whenToUse: A component accepts files from the user and hands them to the consumer for validation and upload.
convention.avoid: Upload progress or results, value changes of non-file inputs, or validation feedback.

convention.name: dropLabel
convention.meaning: Visible text a drop target shows while compatible items are dragged over it.
convention.whenToUse: A drop target replaces its resting text during drag-over, such as Drop here.
convention.avoid: The resting accessible name, error messages or generic hover text.

convention.name: name
convention.meaning: Identifier of the glyph that the Icon component draws from the closed system icon set.
convention.whenToUse: Select which system glyph Icon renders.
convention.avoid: Icon slots inside other components (use leading-icon/icon), native form-control name attributes or arbitrary SVG content.

convention.name: filled
convention.meaning: Renders a stroke glyph with a solid currentColor fill in addition to its stroke.
convention.whenToUse: A glyph needs its solid form, such as a play triangle.
convention.avoid: Selected, pressed or active state, or any color change.

convention.name: external
convention.meaning: The link opens its destination in a new browsing context with safe rel values and an external cue.
convention.whenToUse: A navigational component links to a destination that should open in a new tab, usually outside the product.
convention.avoid: Marking same-tab links as external, download behavior, or styling-only treatments.

convention.name: newTabText
convention.meaning: Readable text announcing that a link opens in a new tab, rendered for assistive technology.
convention.whenToUse: A component that can open a new tab lets consumers localize the notice.
convention.avoid: Replacing the link's accessible name or describing the destination.

convention.name: arrow
convention.meaning: Whether a link shows its trailing decorative direction arrow; the glyph is derived by the component.
convention.whenToUse: A text link may hide its built-in arrow, for example in legal or dense footer links.
convention.avoid: Choosing arbitrary icons or conveying meaning through the arrow alone.

convention.name: rule
convention.meaning: Short code or letter of the review rule that flagged a piece of content, shown next to it.
convention.whenToUse: A highlighted fragment must show which linter or style rule produced it, linking it to its notice.
convention.avoid: Status tone, accessible naming, validation rules of form fields or long rule descriptions.

convention.name: monogram
convention.meaning: The one or two visible characters that identify a product in a compact brand mark.
convention.whenToUse: A compact product mark shows letters instead of artwork.
convention.avoid: Accessible naming (use accessible-name/label), user initials in avatars, or long text.

convention.name: edge
convention.meaning: Pins a thin decorative-or-status strip to the bottom edge of its positioned container, spanning its full width.
convention.whenToUse: A progress or status strip must sit flush on a container edge, such as the SectionNav button.
convention.avoid: Generic positioning, side selection for floating content or layout overrides; the container must be positioned and clip overflow.

convention.name: options
convention.meaning: Ordered list of selectable options, each with a value, a visible text label and optional per-option disabled state; item shape is component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: A selection component renders a standard item for each option from data.
convention.avoid: Custom item rendering (compose primitives instead), navigation items or arbitrary ReactNode collections.

convention.name: orientation
convention.meaning: Main axis of a component's items, which also sets its arrow-key navigation axis.
convention.whenToUse: A component lays out a collection along one axis and its keyboard model follows that axis.
convention.avoid: Purely visual direction changes without keyboard impact, or text direction (use dir).

convention.name: placeholder
convention.meaning: Hint text shown in a choice control while no value is selected; not the accessible name or a default value.
convention.whenToUse: A non-native choice control (such as a Radix Select trigger) needs the equivalent of a native input placeholder.
convention.avoid: Native inputs and textareas, which already have the placeholder attribute; using it as a label, instruction that must stay visible, or selected value.

convention.name: onValueCommit
convention.meaning: Notification of the final value when the user ends a continuous interaction such as a drag or a keyboard step.
convention.whenToUse: A continuous control lets consumers defer expensive work until the user settles on a value, alongside onValueChange.
convention.avoid: Discrete selections where every change is final, form submission or notifications for incoming prop updates.

convention.name: delta
convention.meaning: Short secondary text that gives context to a displayed figure, such as its latest change or why it is unavailable.
convention.whenToUse: A figure component shows a one-line change summary or a no-data reason under its value.
convention.avoid: Accessible naming, long descriptions, help text for form fields or the figure itself.

convention.name: highlighted
convention.meaning: Consumer-controlled, temporary emphasis that draws attention to a component after its content changed.
convention.whenToUse: The consumer briefly emphasizes one item (for example a live total that just changed) and removes the emphasis itself.
convention.avoid: Selection, pressed or current state, persistent status tones, or component-managed timers.

convention.name: pulse
convention.meaning: Whether a live or attention signal indicator plays its pulse animation; reduced-motion preferences always stop it.
convention.whenToUse: A decorative signal indicator offers an optional pulsing emphasis that the consumer can switch to a static presentation.
convention.avoid: Loading or progress animation, general motion toggles for interactive components, or conveying meaning only through motion.

convention.name: content
convention.meaning: Supplementary plain text shown by a floating hint attached to a trigger.
convention.whenToUse: A tooltip-like component shows a short, non-essential, non-interactive description on hover or focus.
convention.avoid: Accessible names, essential instructions, interactive or rich content, or page content slots.

convention.name: side
convention.meaning: The preferred side of the trigger where floating content is placed before collision handling.
convention.whenToUse: A floating component (tooltip, popover, menu) lets the consumer choose top, right, bottom or left.
convention.avoid: Edge pinning inside a container, text direction or alignment along the side.
